issue.title: test_screenshot_copy_and_edit_use_the_same_owned_targets flakes under scoped xdist
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/pager/test_rendered_link_contract.py::test_screenshot_copy_and_edit_use_the_same_owned_targets`
- **Repro:** `sase tool run check` then isolated `.venv/bin/pytest tests/pager/test_rendered_link_contract.py::test_screenshot_copy_and_edit_use_the_same_owned_targets -q`

Failed once in the scoped xdist lane (`just check` / `sase tool run 3a1f72e2bb6dd04b1b1d3a9ddde395cd`, 60865 passed / 2 failed / 17 skipped in 51m14s, load1 20–70). Assertion:

```
assert [] == ['.../CaptureKeyCommandController.swift']
```

after `y` + controller hint; clipboard was empty. The same tree then passed 1/1 in isolation in 8.58s (call 1.47s). Local diff is bead-work nameless-registry recovery only (`src/sase/bead/cli_work_cleanup_targets.py` and tests); it does not touch pager copy/edit. Companion KNOWN failure on `tests/test_preprocessing_code_blocks.py::TestPreprocessPromptCodeBlockProtection::test_text_outside_code_blocks_still_processed` is unrelated (witness b493ad6bfd791a7015fd12a9dedfce43). Adjacent closed flake sase-yp covers a different node in the same file.
